title: Uganda | World Coffee Guide
description: Washed arabica from Mount Elgon can be floral and citrusy, with a sweetness that is easy to like, while Ugandan robusta is heavy and chocolatey and turns up in a lot of espresso blends. Robusta is native to Uganda and makes up most of the harvest, and USDA now counts Uganda among the larger coffee producers in the world.
seoDescription: Uganda coffee guide: Bugisu, Mount Elgon, native robusta, USDA 2026/27 production.
